description: This bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) achieved by three variants of the MADLLM model across six different datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The horizontal axis represents the datasets, listed in alphabetical order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “F1 Score (%)”, is scaled linearly from 60 to 100, with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. For each dataset, three bars are grouped together, representing the performance of MADLLM under different configurations: the green bar corresponds to “MADLLM w/o feature embedding”, the blue bar to “MADLLM w/o prompt pool”, and the orange bar to “MADLLM w/o skip embedding”. The chart visually compares the F1 scores for each configuration within each dataset. For example, in the SMD dataset, all three configurations achieve scores above 90%, with the green bar at approximately 93%, the blue bar at 91%, and the orange bar at 92%. In the PSM dataset, the green bar reaches approximately 98%, the blue bar is around 77%, and the orange bar is approximately 96%. The SWaT dataset shows the green bar at about 91%, the blue bar at 83%, and the orange bar at 86%. In the SMAP dataset, the green bar is at approximately 93%, the blue bar at 69%, and the orange bar at 67%. For the MSL dataset, the green bar is at about 88%, the blue bar at 70%, and the orange bar at 86%. Finally, in the WADI dataset, the green bar is at approximately 74%, the blue bar at 63%, and the orange bar at 68%. The bars are not sorted by height, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard color coding.
